content_name: QA What Is the Best Flooring for Dogs and Kids

actions.caption:
Best flooring for dogs and kids? Rigid-core vinyl plank with a 20 mil+ wear layer.

The wear layer is the clear armor on top. Thicker means more years of nails, spills and dropped toys before it shows.

Runner-up: high-grade laminate. Very hard surface, just mind the water bowl.
Skip in a busy house: soft hardwoods like pine. They'll show every paw print.

Busy house? Buy the wear layer thickness before the look. Today's vinyl looks incredible anyway.

DM us "PETS" and Maria will shortlist floors that survive your crew 🐾
